chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Najran, from Asim ibn Humayd, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:
"Jabir narrated to me from the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), and Jabir was not a liar, that the son of the brother shares inheritance with the grandfather."
ai.seo_question: Does the nephew share inheritance with the grandfather in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* within the chapter on ascendant and descendant inheritance, this hadith clarifies the co-heirship of the paternal grandfather and the son of a brother. The narrator’s emphasis on Jabir’s reliability underscores the authenticity of this specific ruling, which resolves potential conflicts in the distribution of the estate among these specific male relatives.
